tx:
• The chance to activate the scroll of dexterity, which can save leather when crafting items, is multiplied by 1.25.
• If the scroll of dexterity activates, the player gains the Artificer's Measure bonus, providing a 0.5% experience buff to Crafting and Construction (which stacks up to 10 times for 5% more experience) for 5 minutes, which can be refreshed.
• The item acts as an upgraded gem bag, storing 100 of each gem up to dragonstone when using the fill option on the artificer's measure or automatically storing picked up uncut gems. Like the upgraded gem bag, it also allows storage of noted gems, and it stores semi-precious gems, like opal, jade, and topaz.
• The Voice of Seren effect in the Ithell district of Prifddinas, which increases Crafting and Construction experience from playing harps by 20% and makes them less likely to go out of tune, is always applied while playing them regardless of the current Voice of Seren. This does not stack with the actual Ithell Voice of Seren when it is active. 
• There is a 5% chance to duplicate any manufactured items while glassblowing and forming urns. This bonus also works when crafting potion flasks, crystal flasks, and ogre flasks. Duplicated items are sent to the bank.

To create, click on the blessed molten glass or the glorious silvthril chain in the backpack, which brings up crafting glassblowing window. Do not click on the onyx, which may craft onyx bolt tips. It may also be created at a furnace with smelting interface and selecting molten glass and artificer's measure, then begin project.

The primary way to obtain a Brassica Primer is through Farming requests at Manor Farm, as part of the Farming reputation system. Farming requests are a static game mechanic, so the times for requests are the same for everyone. 
Easy requests, which reset daily at 00:00 give a 1/5 chance of receiving one Brassica primer. Medium requests, which reset every 3 days, give a 100% chance of receiving one Brassica primer. Hard requests, which reset every 7 days, give a 100% chance of receiving three Brassica primers.
sc: Brassica primer is an item received from Farming Guild requests that can be consumed to boost the experience gained from harvesting and checking health of farming patches by 10% for 15 minutes.

Regardless of other experience boosts being used, while the Brassica primer is active, you will only be awarded 10% additional Farming reputation than you would normally be awarded if it were not active, i.

This ale is created through the random chance of player made ales maturing, while brewing chef's delights. Maturing occurs during the brewing process, not afterwards. Leaving normal ale in the vat once it has finished brewing will not cause it to turn mature or go bad.
As this ale is player made, it can be collected into a calquat keg, making an Chef's delight (m) (keg). Doing so allows the player to hold 4 doses of this beer in one inventory slot, increasing the value and usefulness of this brew several times over.

tx:
Fishing is by far the most usual way to acquire raw lobsters. Players with level 40 or higher in the Fishing skill can fish for lobsters with a lobster pot. Doing so yields 90 experience for each lobster fished. Depending on the Fishing level, players may get around 30,000-40,000 experience per hour.
Players can steal raw lobsters from the fish stalls in Rellekka and possibly bank them with Peer the Seer if the player is wearing Fremennik sea boots. This method requires level 42 Thieving.
Raw lobsters are on the drop tables of several monsters, such as waterfiends, which commonly drop four noted raw lobsters. However, gathering raw lobsters via combat is inefficient and not recommended.
Raw lobsters are also featured on the rare drop table; 135 to 165 raw lobsters can be obtained in this fashion.
Noted raw lobsters can sometimes be found inside barrels.
sc: A raw lobster is a type of fish that can be caught with level 40 Fishing, giving 90 experience.
They could be obtained from Treasure Hunter or from healing Icxan, the wounded snake, during the Zodiac Training event.
